pr_title: Clean up canvas light shader API.
pr_body:
Fixes: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/66508

Exposes ``LIGHT_ENERGY`` and ``LIGHT_IS_DIRECTIONAL``. These were both exposed internally, but just needed to be added to the shader type definition.

Add ``LIGHT_DIRECTION``. This gets initialized differently based on whether the light is directional or not. This allows users to write their shaders without checking whether the light is directional. Now users can recreate the built-in lighting that Godot offers in their own shader and tweak it as necessary. This also avoids the current awkwardness of passing the DirectionalLight2Ds direction in ``LIGHT_POSITION.xy``

Updated docs: https://github.com/godotengine/godot-docs/pull/6240

issue_context.title: LIGHT_POSITION in canvas shader Light processor does not work as expected.
comments:
For directional lights ``LIGHT_POSITION.xy`` is the direction but ``LIGHT_POSITION.z`` is still the lights height. The docs should be updated to reflect this. 

There is also a ``is_directional`` boolean in the shader code that needs to be exposed to users so you can have different logic for directional lights
